note: Registry of implemented rule procedures. Presence here is code coverage, not SRD parity.

procedures.name: level_for_xp
procedures.doc: The highest level whose accumulated-XP threshold has been reached.

procedures.name: xp_for_next_level
procedures.doc: The accumulated XP needed for the next level, or ``None`` at the cap.

procedures.name: attack_bonus
procedures.doc: Half the character's level, rounded down — full level with the On Target Edge.

procedures.name: save_target
procedures.doc: ``16 - level`` before attribute modifiers; 15 at first level, as the SRD notes.

procedures.name: skill_points_for_level
procedures.doc: Three points per level, plus one with the Educated Edge.

procedures.name: skill_point_cost
procedures.doc: Point cost of the *next* rank: every rank is bought in order.

procedures.name: skill_rank_allowed
procedures.doc: Whether a character is high enough level to hold this rank.

procedures.name: total_skill_cost
procedures.doc: Points required to reach ``target_rank`` from untrained, buying each rank in order.

procedures.name: attribute_boost_cost
procedures.doc: The nth attribute boost costs n points (first 1, second 2, ... fifth 5).

procedures.name: attribute_boost_allowed
procedures.doc: Whether the character is high enough level for that boost.

procedures.name: focus_picks_at
procedures.doc: How many Focus picks a character of this level has had (levels 2, 5, 7, 10).

procedures.name: has_third_edge
procedures.doc: The third Edge becomes selectable at fifth level.

procedures.name: hit_points_rolled
procedures.doc: The total of the level's hit dice, each with the Constitution modifier, floored at 1.

procedures.name: new_maximum_hit_points
procedures.doc: Take the roll if it beats the current maximum, otherwise gain one point.

procedures.name: attack_modifier
procedures.doc: Sum the SRD modifiers for the named circumstances.

procedures.name: attack_modifier_for
procedures.doc: Iterable form of :func:`attack_modifier`.

procedures.name: in_melee_penalty
procedures.doc: The penalty for firing while an enemy is in melee range.

procedures.name: AttributeBonus
procedures.doc: ``+2 Physical`` and friends: a size and which attributes may receive it.

procedures.name: grant_free_skill
procedures.doc: The free skill arrives at level-0 before any other choice is made.

procedures.name: specific_picks
procedures.doc: Two picks from the Learning table, the same skill twice allowed.

procedures.name: growth_rolls
procedures.doc: Three rolls, each naming its table and its die result.

procedures.name: resolve_table_entry
procedures.doc: A d20 result indexes the table; out-of-range results are refused, not clamped.

procedures.name: apply_attribute_bonus
procedures.doc: Apply ``+N Physical`` and friends, splitting between attributes of that kind.

procedures.name: ContactBook
procedures.doc: Starting contacts: two acquaintances *or* one friend, and never a mix.

methods.name: ContactBook.promote
methods.doc: An acquaintance can become a friend; the book must still be legal.

procedures.name: roll_attributes
procedures.doc: Six 3d6 rolls taken in order, one per attribute.

procedures.name: substitute_fourteen
procedures.doc: Replace one rolled score with 14.

procedures.name: assign_array
procedures.doc: Assign the fixed array across the attributes.

procedures.name: effective_modifier
procedures.doc: The attribute modifier, plus any Focus or cyberware bonus.

procedures.name: SkillPool
procedures.doc: The skill picks a character makes during creation.

methods.name: SkillPool.pick
methods.doc: Spend one pick; returns the resulting level.

methods.name: SkillPool.open_skills
methods.doc: Skills a surplus pick may legally be spent on.

procedures.name: attack_roll
procedures.signature: (*, attribute_score, skill_level, attack_bonus, armor_class, other_modifier=..., rng=..., die=...)
procedures.doc: Roll an attack or resolve an already supplied d20 result.

procedures.name: TurnBudget
procedures.doc: Main/Move bookkeeping for one combatant in one round.

methods.name: TurnBudget.convert_main_to_move
methods.doc: Spend the Main action to gain a second Move action.

procedures.name: snap_attack_penalty
procedures.doc: The Snap Attack penalty, or an error when the Main action is already spent.

procedures.name: swarm_bonus
procedures.doc: Bonuses for a Swarm Attack by one of up to four attackers on the same target.

procedures.name: charge
procedures.doc: Validate a Charge and return its modifiers.

procedures.name: total_defense
procedures.doc: The Total Defense stance, or an error when the Main action is already spent.

procedures.name: Save
procedures.doc: One resolved saving throw.

methods.name: Save.natural
methods.doc: True on a natural 1 or natural 20 — the two results the die decides alone.

procedures.name: save_target
procedures.doc: The d20 target for ``kind``, from SRD 2.2.0.

procedures.name: saving_throw
procedures.doc: Roll ``1d20`` against the save target.

procedures.name: is_traumatic_hit
procedures.doc: SRD 2.4.6.3: the Trauma Die meeting or exceeding the Trauma Target.

procedures.name: trauma_damage
procedures.doc: Multiply the **total** damage by the weapon's Trauma Rating on a Traumatic Hit.

procedures.name: shock_applies
procedures.doc: Whether Shock lands: **only on a miss**, and only if the target's AC is within the rating.

procedures.name: shock_damage
procedures.signature: (*, hit, shock_value, shock_ac, target_melee_ac, attribute_modifier=..., explicit_bonus=...)
procedures.doc: Shock inflicted on a miss, or ``0``.

procedures.name: damage_floor
procedures.doc: SRD 2.4.6.4: a hit never deals less than the Shock that a miss would have dealt.

procedures.name: shock_can_cause_trauma
procedures.doc: False by SRD 2.4.6.4 — exposed as a function so a caller cannot forget the invariant.

procedures.name: resolve_attack
procedures.signature: (*, hit, total_damage=..., trauma_die=..., trauma_rating=..., trauma_target=..., shock_value=..., shock_ac=..., target_melee_ac=..., attribute_modifier=..., explicit_shock_bonus=...)
procedures.doc: One attack's damage, with the SRD's three Shock invariants enforced in order.

procedures.name: major_injury_risk
procedures.doc: SRD 2.5.6: lethal damage to zero HP, in a scene where a Traumatic Hit already landed.

procedures.name: resolve_downed
procedures.signature: (*, lethal, hit_points, traumatic_this_scene, level, attributes, save_bonus=..., save_die=..., injury_roll=..., rng=...)
procedures.doc: What happens when a subject reaches zero hit points.

procedures.name: strain_maximum
procedures.doc: Allowed maximum System Strain = Constitution score, adjusted by lifestyle.

procedures.name: installation_terms
procedures.doc: Cost, recovery time and surgery difficulty for an implant of a given strain cost (SRD 3.6.1).

procedures.name: can_accept_implant
procedures.doc: SRD 3.6.1: "A subject cannot accept cyber if it would put their System Strain above their maximum".

procedures.name: resolve_implant_surgery
procedures.doc: The outcome of implant surgery.

procedures.name: maintenance_minutes
procedures.doc: SRD 3.6.4: upkeep takes hours equal to the system's System Strain, minimum fifteen minutes.

procedures.name: maintenance_overdue
procedures.doc: SRD 3.6.4: "If a system goes more than a month without upkeep, it starts to malfunction".

procedures.name: first_aid
procedures.doc: SRD 2.5.1: a medkit patch-up restores ``1d6 + Heal``, or ``1d6 - 1`` with no Heal skill at all.

procedures.name: Drone
procedures.doc: One row of the SRD 3.8.1 table.

procedures.name: Command
procedures.doc: How many drones a controller can drive at once (SRD 3.8.4).

methods.name: Command.capacity
methods.doc: A control board drives one; an RCU drives ``1 + Drive skill``.

procedures.name: control_penalty
procedures.doc: SRD 3.8.4: a control board imposes -2 on the drone's hit rolls and skill checks.

procedures.name: range_status
procedures.doc: Three tiers, not two.

procedures.name: mount_class
procedures.doc: SRD 3.8.1: base Encumbrance 3 or less -> pistol-sized; larger man-portable -> rifle-sized;

procedures.name: charge_hours
procedures.doc: SRD 3.8.0: "one hour of charging per Encumbrance, or six hours at most".

procedures.name: parts_cost
procedures.doc: SRD 3.8.4.3: "Spare parts for a drone cost 25% of the drone's base cost".

procedures.name: skill_through_drone
procedures.doc: SRD 3.8.4.1: skill checks use the operator's level, capped at their Drive skill.

procedures.name: gunnery_bonus
procedures.signature: (*, base_attack_bonus, drive_skill, program_skill, int_modifier, dex_modifier, autonomous=...)
procedures.doc: SRD 3.8.4.1: operator's hit bonus + better of Drive/Program, modified by Int or Dex.

procedures.name: drone_attack_bonuses
procedures.doc: SRD 3.8.4.2: the pilot directs **one** attack; "all others fire at the drone's usual attack

procedures.name: is_destroyed
procedures.doc: SRD 3.8.4.3: "A drone reduced to zero hit points has been destroyed, and cannot be repaired.".

procedures.name: TalentSheet
procedures.doc: The selections a character has made, and the budget they were made against.

methods.name: TalentSheet.edge_slots
methods.doc: Two at start, a third at fifth level, plus one for the Underdog Rule.

procedures.name: attribute_modifier_total
procedures.doc: The sum of the six attribute modifiers, which is what the Underdog Rule tests.

procedures.name: underdog_eligible
procedures.doc: A character with a modifier total of -1 or less may claim the bonus Edge.

procedures.name: can_raise_attributes_with_skill_points
procedures.doc: The Underdog Rule's price: no later attribute increases from skill points.

procedures.name: pick_edge
procedures.doc: Spend an Edge slot.

procedures.name: focus_slots
procedures.doc: One Focus at start, two with the Focused Edge.

procedures.name: pick_focus
procedures.doc: Take a Focus, or raise an existing one by a level; returns the new level.

procedures.name: stowed_capacity
procedures.doc: Stowed points a character can carry without penalty: their Strength.

procedures.name: readied_capacity
procedures.doc: Readied points without penalty: half Strength, rounded down.

procedures.name: tier_for
procedures.doc: ``normal``, ``heavy`` (first push), ``overloaded`` (second push) or ``immobile``.

procedures.name: move_speed
procedures.doc: The character's Move speed in metres for this load.

procedures.name: can_haul
procedures.doc: Whether the load can be carried over a significant distance at all.

procedures.name: bundled_points
procedures.doc: Points for small identical items tied into bundles of three.

procedures.name: kilograms_to_points
procedures.doc: Convert bulk weight to encumbrance points (25 kg ≈ 10 points).

procedures.name: load_equipment
procedures.doc: Load the catalogue once and return it with ``weapons``/``armor`` keyed by id.

procedures.name: find_weapon
procedures.doc: Look a weapon up by its printed name, case- and space-insensitively.

procedures.name: parse_damage
procedures.doc: ``1d10+2`` → ``(1, 10, 2)``. Firing-mode markers are irrelevant to the dice.

procedures.name: damage_profile
procedures.doc: The row decomposed into the shape the combat kernel and the Godot adapter take.

procedures.name: Focus
procedures.doc: A Focus and how many levels it has.

procedures.name: focused_edge
procedures.doc: SRD 1.6.0: "A new character may choose one Focus, plus one more if they have the Focused Edge".

procedures.name: advancement_picks
procedures.doc: How many Focus picks the character has earned from levelling (SRD 2.7.1.6).

procedures.name: total_picks
procedures.doc: Creation pick(s) plus every advancement pick earned so far.

procedures.name: can_take_level
procedures.doc: Whether the next pick in this Focus is legal.

procedures.name: take_level
procedures.doc: Return the Focus's new level after spending a pick, or raise if the pick is illegal.

procedures.name: gear_budget
procedures.doc: SRD 1.6.2: the free-gear budget for Ace Driver/Roamer (vehicle) or Drone Pilot (drone).

methods.name: Mod.price
methods.doc: Absolute mods carry a dollar price; drone, deck and hull mods a percentage.

procedures.name: maintenance_score
procedures.doc: How many mods one tech can keep working.

procedures.name: can_maintain
procedures.doc: A tech may only maintain mods they could have built.

procedures.name: install_weeks
procedures.doc: One week per minimum skill level, halved by an assistant, then by obsession.

procedures.name: maintenance_lapse
procedures.doc: ``working``, ``mod_dead`` or ``item_dead`` — the SRD's 24 h and 7 day clocks.

procedures.name: craft_plan
procedures.doc: Jury-rigged, normal or mastercrafted: time, parts bill, and the strings attached.

procedures.name: factory_price
procedures.doc: Factory-modded gear starts at five times the mod's build price, then doubles per component.

procedures.name: apply_weapon_mods
procedures.doc: Apply mods to a ``cwn_equipment.damage_profile`` row.

procedures.name: apply_armor_mods
procedures.doc: Apply armor mods to a ``cwn_equipment`` armor row.

procedures.name: apply_drone_mods
procedures.doc: Drone hull stats: AC, Move, HP, fitting and hardpoint counts, Encumbrance.

procedures.name: apply_deck_mods
procedures.doc: Cyberdeck stats: CPU, Memory, Shielding, Bonus Access, Encumbrance.

procedures.name: access_pool
procedures.doc: ``INT modifier + Program + the deck's Bonus Access``. Never negative.

procedures.name: security_difficulty
procedures.doc: The network's security level plus the SRD's situation modifiers.

procedures.name: cyberware_difficulty
procedures.doc: ``7 + ceil(HD or level / 3)``; a drone with no connected operator is difficulty 8.

procedures.name: HackCheck
procedures.doc: One Int/Program check behind a Verb.

procedures.name: hacking_check
procedures.signature: (*, intelligence_score, program_skill, difficulty, wireless=..., vr_crown=..., verb_modifier=..., situational=..., rng=..., dice=...)
procedures.doc: Roll the check a run-program action needs, with the connection penalties kept flat.

procedures.name: AlertClock
procedures.doc: The network's intruder clock: two failed checks per Alert action, two actions to alert.

methods.name: AlertClock.record_failure
methods.doc: Record a failed check. True when this failure completes the network alert.

methods.name: AlertClock.record_alert_action
methods.doc: A demon or watchdog spent its Main action alerting. True when the network is alerted.

procedures.name: SystemStrain
procedures.doc: A compatibility view over :class:`cwn_strain.SystemStrain`.

methods.name: SystemStrain.current
methods.doc: Total Strain carried: permanent load plus what rest can clear.

methods.name: SystemStrain.shedable
methods.doc: The share a good night's sleep can clear; implant load never is.

methods.name: SystemStrain.add
methods.doc: Apply strain if there is room; a body at its maximum gains nothing.

methods.name: SystemStrain.add_permanent
methods.doc: Cyberware: taken from the ceiling, never shed while the implant stays.

methods.name: SystemStrain.nights_sleep
methods.doc: One shedable point leaves per qualifying night; permanent never does.

procedures.name: Patient
procedures.doc: Just enough state to run the procedures.

methods.name: Patient.mortally_wounded
methods.doc: Zero hit points from a lethal attack means dying, not merely resting.

methods.name: Patient.rounds_until_death
methods.doc: Rounds left before the sixth round after downing has passed.

procedures.name: stabilize_difficulty
procedures.doc: Difficulty 8 plus each full round elapsed, two harder without a medkit.

procedures.name: stabilized
procedures.doc: A stabilized patient wakes with one hit point after ten minutes, and is Frail.

procedures.name: remove_frailty
procedures.doc: One medkit, one hour, one roll - and only one chance per Frailty.

procedures.name: natural_healing
procedures.doc: A night's rest restores level or hit dice in HP - but never to the Frail.

procedures.name: frail_week
procedures.doc: The week of bed rest that decides whether frailty ends or kills.

procedures.name: first_aid
procedures.doc: Minutes of care: 1d6 plus Heal level, or 1d6-1 with no Heal skill at all.

procedures.name: resolve_zero_hit_points
procedures.signature: (*, hit_points_after, traumatic_in_fight, lethal=..., level, attributes, save_die=..., save_bonus=..., injury_roll=..., injury_modifier=...)
procedures.doc: Run the procedure for a character who has just taken damage.

procedures.name: MajorInjury
procedures.doc: One row of the d12 table, with the consequences expressed as flags.

methods.name: MajorInjury.is_permanent_without_treatment
methods.doc: Whether ordinary stabilisation is not enough to restore the character.

procedures.name: clamp_injury_roll
procedures.doc: Clamp a d12 roll into 1..12, as the SRD requires.

procedures.name: injury_for_roll
procedures.doc: The row for a roll, clamped.

procedures.name: resolve_major_injury
procedures.doc: Apply the table, clamping the adjusted roll into 1..12 as the SRD requires.

procedures.name: requires_prosthetic
procedures.doc: Whether a Prosthetic Cyber (or cloned tissue) is needed to restore function.

procedures.name: damaged_cyber_locations
procedures.doc: Cyber locations the injury critically damages (empty when none are named).

procedures.name: is_lethal
procedures.doc: Instant death, the one outcome no treatment undoes.

procedures.name: dies_without_care_within
procedures.doc: Hours to death if the character never reaches a street doc, or ``None``.

procedures.name: SystemStrain
procedures.doc: A character's Strain: permanent cyberware load plus temporary, recoverable load.

methods.name: SystemStrain.maximum
methods.doc: The allowed maximum: the Constitution score.

methods.name: SystemStrain.total
methods.doc: Permanent plus temporary Strain.

methods.name: SystemStrain.available
methods.doc: How much Strain the character can still take.

methods.name: SystemStrain.can_absorb
methods.doc: Whether an addition would stay within the maximum.

methods.name: SystemStrain.absorb
methods.doc: Add Strain if it fits.

methods.name: SystemStrain.rest_night
methods.doc: Recover one point after a qualifying night's rest; returns what was recovered.

methods.name: SystemStrain.install_cyber
methods.doc: Add permanent Strain for an implant, if the body can support it.

methods.name: SystemStrain.remove_cyber
methods.doc: Remove an implant's permanent Strain, never below zero.

procedures.name: Shock
procedures.doc: A Shock rating: its value and the highest Melee AC it reaches.

methods.name: Shock.applies_to
methods.doc: Whether a miss would reach a target at this Armour Class.

procedures.name: absorb_with_soak
procedures.doc: Return (damage reaching hit points, soak remaining).

procedures.name: is_traumatic
procedures.doc: Delegate to the core: the Trauma Die meeting or exceeding the target.

procedures.name: shock_on_miss
procedures.doc: Shock from a missed attack, or 0.

procedures.name: major_injury_risk
procedures.doc: Zero hit points only threaten a Major Injury once trauma has landed.

procedures.name: resolve_hit
procedures.signature: (weapon, *, damage_roll, attribute_modifier=..., skill_bonus=..., trauma_die_roll=..., trauma_target=..., target_melee_ac=..., soak=..., lethal=..., shock_immune=..., barrier_spent=..., traumatic_damage_earlier_in_fight=..., current_hit_points=...)
procedures.doc: Resolve a hit that has already landed.

procedures.name: load_vehicles
procedures.doc: Load the vehicle contract once (cached) and return it verbatim.

methods.name: Vehicle.armored
methods.doc: A null Armor with no note is Armor 0 — reachable, just not armoured.

procedures.name: VehicleModification
procedures.doc: A vehicle mod: priced as a percentage of the hull's base cost.

procedures.name: size_allows
procedures.doc: Min. Size is a *floor*: a large hull may mount a small fitting.

procedures.name: FittedVehicle
procedures.doc: A hull plus what has been bolted onto it, with the budgets resolved.

procedures.name: fit_out
procedures.doc: Resolve a hull + fittings + mods, or raise :class:`VehicleError`.

procedures.name: armor_class_in_combat
procedures.doc: A stationary hull is easier to hit; a moving one adds its driver's Drive skill.

procedures.name: can_be_harmed
procedures.doc: ``True``/``False`` when the contract settles it, ``None`` when the referee does.

procedures.name: damage_to_vehicle
procedures.doc: Multiply for a Traumatic Hit first, then subtract Armor (SRD 2.5.1/2.5.1.3).

procedures.name: CrashResult
procedures.doc: One passenger's outcome after a hull is destroyed or goes out of control.

methods.name: CrashResult.damage_fraction
methods.doc: Both saves: none. One save: half maximum hit points. Neither: mortally wounded.

procedures.name: destruction_damage
procedures.doc: Occupants take the damage that killed the hull; a Luck save halves it.

procedures.name: RamResult
procedures.doc: Ramming: opposed DEX/Drive vs DEX/Exert, then an Evasion save against people.

procedures.name: ram_person
procedures.doc: A person takes the hull's *maximum* hit points, with a 1d12/x3 Trauma Die.

procedures.name: ram_vehicle
procedures.doc: Vehicle-on-vehicle: no Evasion save, and the rammer takes the same damage back.

procedures.name: repair_estimate
procedures.doc: One hit point per day, plus the technician's Fix and Drive skill.

methods.name: ChaseOutcome.caught_by
methods.doc: Strictly greater, not greater-or-equal: a tie is an escape.

procedures.name: hindrance_bonus
procedures.doc: Each successful hindrance is +1 to the fleeing pace, capped at +3.

procedures.name: vehicle_chase_modifier
procedures.signature: (*, cannot_see_target=..., pursuer_flying=..., pursued_flying=..., spotter=..., terrain_knowledge=..., half_hearted=..., enraged=...)

procedures.name: resolve_action
procedures.signature: (actor, target, *, action, acting_asset, target_asset, die, bonus=..., difficulty=..., damage=...)
procedures.doc: Resolve one pending strategic attack without silently taking extra turns.

procedures.name: relocate_asset
procedures.doc: Resolve a previously committed move with explicit map authorization.

procedures.name: PsychicTraining
procedures.doc: Track a character's disciplines, advancement and learned techniques.

methods.name: PsychicTraining.learn_technique
methods.doc: Register a GM-approved catalogue entry once its prerequisites are met.

procedures.name: Psychic
procedures.doc: Effort is reserved rather than expended; different reservations recover at different times.

methods.name: Psychic.capacity
methods.doc: SWN Revised Effort: 1 + best(WIS, CON) modifier + highest discipline rank.

methods.name: Psychic.release
methods.doc: Only active commitments can be voluntarily freed immediately.

procedures.name: resolve_attack
procedures.doc: Explicit die input guarantees deterministic tests, save/replay and Godot parity.

procedures.name: ContinuityRegistry
procedures.doc: Track separate agents rather than overwriting identity on copying.

procedures.name: attribute_modifier
procedures.doc: The modifier for an attribute score (SRD 1.1.2).

procedures.name: clamp_situational
procedures.doc: Circumstances adjust a check by at most -2..+2 (SRD 2.3.1).

procedures.name: clamp_aid
procedures.doc: Aid tops out at +1 however many allies help (SRD 2.3.3).

procedures.name: Check
procedures.doc: One resolved skill check.

procedures.name: skill_check
procedures.signature: (*, attribute_score, skill_level, difficulty, situational=..., aid=..., rng=..., dice=...)
procedures.doc: `2d6 + attribute modifier + skill level` against a difficulty.

procedures.name: opposed_check
procedures.doc: Opposed checks: the higher roll wins (SRD 2.3.4).

procedures.name: Save
procedures.doc: One resolved saving throw.

procedures.name: save_target
procedures.doc: ``16 - level - the higher of the two listed attribute modifiers``; Luck has none.

procedures.name: roll_save
procedures.doc: Roll a save: a natural 1 always fails and a natural 20 always succeeds.

procedures.name: from_legacy_stat
procedures.doc: Map a legacy 1..10 STAT onto a 3..18 attribute, preserving rank order (1 -> 3, 10 -> 18).

procedures.name: from_legacy_skill
procedures.doc: Map a legacy 1..10 skill rating onto a level 0..4 (1..2 -> 0, 3..4 -> 1, ... 9..10 -> 4).
